note: Nomination-day report for the sixteen divisions of Hillsborough rural district, one member each. Eight divisions received a single nomination and are listed here; in Ballymacbrennan, Ballyskeagh, Breda, Carryduff, Drumbo, Edenderry and Ougley no nomination was made and the retiring members were deemed re-elected, but their names were not printed. Filed on Friday 30 May 1930, the day appointed by Down County Council for the county and rural district elections (Banbridge Chronicle, 15 March 1930, p. 2); previously filed under 1930-06-05 (provisional) (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
